notes.title: Commander: Modern War release
notes.notes:
In celebration of the recently launched Commander: Modern War, it has added the ALL IN 1 bundle, where you can get the bundle at 60% off.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/28543/All_in_1__Best_of_Turns/

Commander: Modern war features a two-sided single-player campaign where you can play as the Alliance or the Coalition, as well as skirmish maps where players can battle against up to seven other commanders. Players will also be able to customize their experience by choosing different parameters on the maps, such as the number of players involved in the battle, faction, team, colors, and many others. With the addition of a Map Editor, players can even create their own custom maps to battle on.

The gameplay in Commander: Modern War is both challenging and rewarding. Players will need to deploy their units strategically to take advantage of the terrain and use specialized units to counter their opponents. As they progress through the game, they will be able to recruit new units and capture different locations, ensuring a steady income to keep their army growing.

The release of Commander: Modern War is sure to be a hit with fans of turn-based tactical games, and those looking for an immersive, action-packed gaming experience. With its extensive single-player campaign, skirmish maps, and Map Editor, there is no shortage of things to do in this exciting new title. So why wait? Get ready to experience the thrill of modern warfare and take control of your troops in Commander: Modern War.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2214890/Commander_Modern_War/

notes.title: Paths & Danger, game just release!
notes.notes:
Greetings!

For all fans of Expect the Unexpected, we recently released the game Paths & Danger.

Paths & Danger is a procedural turn-based RPG with a more simplistic approach to the tactical genre. Join in on an adventure where you must gather a balanced group of heroes to embark on a series of jobs and quests and uncover the great mystery surrounding the province of Westwall.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1403990/Paths__Danger/

Paths & Danger storyline happens in the same world as the Expect the Unexpected. So you should really expect the unexpected

Get Paths & Danger with a release discount of 20% off!

notes.title: Major Update/Patch 1.2.0.0
notes.notes:
[Updates]

- Now you can check the factions influence zone, just point the mouse at the a flag in the map
- Now you can repair items (weapons, shields, armors and helmets) in towns
- Companion now can grab health potions and apples to heal himself
- Can set companion for auto move/attack
- New attack defense icons
- Better Level Up display
- Added tooltip in the Skills tab to display the class bonus
- Added healing effect
- Chest open sounds
- More alignments added
- New reputation information display
- New farms images according to the region
- Selection aura according to the current alignment
- Priestess event have more outcomes
- Witch behave differently
- Witch event, will no longer give free mysterious potions
- Santa hat removed

[Fixes]

- Correct the mouse flickering when attack/charge/aim
- Achivement learn all spells not unlocking
- Corrected some typos mistakes and grammar corrections
- Drag/drop bug by setting favourite permanently fixed
- Can directly move to an item to grab it
- Bug when having a companion selected and try to cast a spell
- Message to indicate when you have full inventory and try to unequip a item by pressing the unequip button
- Corrected a rare occurrence where you could get stuck with no travel button available
- Change some events outcomes

notes.title: Update 1.1.0.0
notes.notes:
[New features]
- Now you can sleep in the cities, restoring health and magic.
- New inventory drag system, drag to reorganize, equip, drop items.
- Next turn button, so you can pass a turn without any action.
- Prices are highlighted in cities for buying or selling items.
- Two new  music tracks added for non desert maps.
- New tutorial about disguising and the advantages it brings.

[Fixes]
- Fixed a rare occurrence where after dead the riddle generated negative numbers
- Fixed a bug where some npc's showing having 0 or negative attack damage
- Fixed minor errors and balances.
- Fixed a bug where your unlocked classes (Archer, Wizard) could be lost and locked again.

notes.title: New Update 1.0.3.0
notes.notes:
Mid week update! 

[New features]

- There's a chance you can pick up apples in forests.
- South passage added in the goblin mountains (2 more travel points).
- Added a coin sound for every gold transaction.
- Added a sound when a item breaks.
- Free States event trader now has a larger variety of items to sell.
- Witch laughter.

[Balances]

- Goblin treasure event will no longer remove both items and gold.
- Change caravan guards appearance to not mistaken with Free States soldiers
- Apple now heals 5 hp.

[Bugs fixed]

- Unlocking Archer and Wizard display after collecting the required runes to unlock.
- Fixed a bug where a follower could be loaded after being killed.
- Corrected event where you could pay the hairdresser without the required gold
- Corrected bridge ambush event where you could pay without having gold
- Correct event where an imperial ask for gold, leaving you with negative balance
- Corrected a bug where you died and the screen turned black without being sent to "after life"
- Fixed an event where Imperial soldiers turn enemy when you decided to help them.
- Correct other minor events bugs and glitch.

notes.title: Major Patch Update 1.0.2.0
notes.notes:
We are committed to make Expect The Unexpected the best experience possible and will continue to support it for a very long time. You must know that we read all your comments and fixed all mentioned errors. Please stay tuned for this following week's update featuring new features and improvements.

[NEWS AND BALANCES]

- Set follower limit to 1
- Riddle to cheat death now haves more time to solve according to difficulty
- Prices of potions now according to the difficulty 
- HINTS now displayed in loading
- Attack/Health Points/Defense of NPC's fixed according to the difficulty
- Item drops fixed according to the difficulty
- Display message if lack of Magic
- Jobs reward gold (coin sound) immediately after completing the event
- Fixed price to pay for travel in port cities according to the difficulty

[BUGS FIXED]

- Save follower now works properly
- Follower will no longer be present after death
- Follower will appear next to you in ambushes
- Bug Fixed if follower kills final enemy the travel button didn't appear
- Displaying wrong tiles while on night events fixed
- Fixed an event where a beggar is not displayed as a beggar
- Fixed a bug where a merchant didn't drop the item he was trying to sell
- Fixed events where characters turned hostile but just stood still (blocking the Travel button)
- Fixed event where the haircut wasn't being made properly (now saves too)
- Fixed bug where ancient ruins where not displaying making impossible to recover runes
- Fixed a bug when Savahn's Soldiers were displaying wrong heads
- Fixed a bug where if you resurrected with the 12 runes you couldn't continue

We will continue to update the game with better content and features.
If you have feedback on this update or just the game in general, please let us know. We really appreciate it.
